name: dev.jobspipe/mcp
title: JobsPipe
description: Search live job postings from 30+ ATS feeds and job boards, normalized to one schema. Live results need a Bearer API key; the no-key demo at https://jobspipe.dev/mcp returns the REST call to run instead of postings.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer jp_live_<key> - create a free key at https://jobspipe.dev/signup (dashboard Settings -> API Keys).
